notes.title: upcoming v0.8.1
notes.content:
I had some trouble changing the current build as I did not receive the code via SMS. I then opted to use the Steam Mobile App for a more efficient resolution of the issue. Unfortunately, Steam blocked my account from making changes to the build for the next 72 hours, as using the Steam Mobile App and activating it is considered a security setting change.

Once support processes my last request (or 72 hours have passed), I will upload the new build. That said, here’s what has changed with the new build:

- Battles are finally happening in the overworld again.
- Adjusted camera stack and layering to improve post-processing effects.
- Further VFX adjustments.
- UI changes.
- One save slot was added; the game now saves after each completed floor. Simply quit and resume where you left off.
- Increased overall brightness.
- SFX adjustments.
- New boss theme.
- You can now access the RECORD from the TITLE menu. You can check all cards you found while exploring the dungeon and get a summary of each lore bit you’ve discovered.
